question: Who is said to have performed worship in the Krita age across the ages?
premises: Worship is said to occur in every age.
In the Krita age, Guha performed worship.
inference: Guha is identified as the worshipper in the Krita age.
uncertainties: The identity of Guha is not further specified in this verse.
plain_english: In every age worship is performed; in the Krita age, Guha worshipped.
